messages:
ryn: spotted a PEM blob in a build artifact for tokenizer-svc (us-central). looks like client cert + key. snippet below (sanitized).

ryn: ```
...
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIE...
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIF...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
...
```

omar: copy. immediate steps: page oncall, revoke, rotate, rewrap, remove unwrap from CI.

oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-6012 "tokenizer-svc CI key leak (us-central)". Assigned: omar, sasha. Severity: P2.

sasha: i'll run CA revoke and issue new cert ttl=8h. omar, can you remove kms:Decrypt from the build SA?

omar: already working on IAM patch. changing ci-builder role to encrypter-only. adding condition to allow unwrap only from rotator service.

omar: IAM snippet: `role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterOnly` for ci-builder, and `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for rotator@infra with resource condition.

rotator-bot: Suggested flow: create new KMS key version, rewrap secret, deploy cert, purge edge session caches, run handshake canary. Tag events with rotator:tokenizer.

sasha: running rewrap: `kmsctl rewrap --key tokenizer-key --new-version v4 --resource secrets/tokenizer/ci --tag rotator:tokenizer`

sasha: CA revoke OK. new cert issued. rotator logs show rewrap success.

omar: queueing proxy purge in us-central: `curl -X POST https://proxy-api.internal/us-central/purge -d '{"service":"tokenizer-svc"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROXY_TOKEN"`

ryn: question: session resumption could still allow old connections for a bit. can we set session_ticket_ttl=15s during rollout?

sasha: yes. staging that on proxy pool now, will revert after 5m. also increasing healthcheck retries by 3 for rollout window to avoid flapping.

omar: SIEM search for external fetches returned only internal CI instance IDs. forwarding results to ticket.

rotator-bot: follow-ups recommended: redact PEMs from CI logs, add CI pre-commit secret-scan, alert on any KMS unwraps by CI accounts, extend kms.rewrap audit retention to 2y, add automated cross-region mTLS smoke tests.

sasha: opened infra PR to redact PEM patterns and fail builds if found (#infra/ci-redact). also PR to lockdown IAM for CI.

omar: marking incident as monitored. will keep channel open for 36h. thanks all. :thumbsup:
